submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.884 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance improvement of 31% over Mixture-G1 and 56% over Mixture-G2 at the same gap size. The simulation systematically evaluated all three candidate mixtures at gaps of 1mm, 2mm, and 3mm. Mixture-G3 consistently outperformed the alternatives, and the 2mm gap provided the optimal balance for this mixture. The 2mm gap falls within the required 1-3mm constraint range, and Mixture-G3 is one of the approved candidates from the specification document.
